en:settings.bot.browser.featureOff.text: Turn on the built-in browser in App settings → Computer & browser → Built-in browser.
en:settings.bot.browser.featureOff.en: Turn on the built-in browser in App settings → Computer & browser → Built-in browser.
en:settings.bot.browser.featureOff.note: Pass after change (COPY-REVIEW.md, g9-ux-fable). The gear is labelled App settings in sentence case, so the path uses that casing; Turn on replaces Enable because the control is a switch. Computer & browser and Built-in browser match settings.page.computer and the companion.browser card. No em dash; arrows are the existing path style.
